name: Pinball Arcade: Al’s Garage Band Goes on a World Tour
storyline: Al's Garage Band Goes on a World Tour (1992) is a Rockin table with Rad Action Features designed by Michael Gottlieb and Jerry Armstrong for Alvin G. and Co. which was founded in 1991 by Alvin Gottlieb, and closed in 1996 after producing 8 games. Al's Garage Band is a great example of the innovative tables the company produced. The table features the Worlds First Spinning Ramp, the CD Ramp, and Bump Buttons, which were flipper buttons attached to a small coil to provide player feedback. Other features include the Guitar Mini Playfield, Feed Back Kicker, and Music Video Mode. 1,000 units of this table were produced.
